svg.title: GSE42568 target-gene expression heatmap
svg.desc: Row-wise sample-standardized expression for 38 individual probes across 17 normal breast and 104 breast cancer samples. Columns are ordered by group. Z-scores are clipped for display between minus two and plus two.
svg.text: 38 individual GPL570 probes | 121 samples | row-wise Z-scores
Blue = below that probe average; white = near average;
red = above average. Colour is clipped at -2 and +2.

svg.text: Each row is one probe. Its Z-score is (sample measurement - that probe mean across all 121 samples) / that probe sample standard deviation.
Columns are ordered as 17 normal samples, then 104 cancer samples. Sample accessions are printed vertically; hover a cell or label for its title and Z-score.
* PTEN probe 217492_s_at is annotated to both PTEN and PTENP1. Probes remain separate; this descriptive heatmap does not test group differences.
